A US mobile carrier for small businesses, with the answering built into the line rather than bolted onto it. You get a real number with unlimited calls and texts for $99 a month, and an AI that picks up when you can't. It books the job, answers the usual questions and texts you what happened. One company, one bill, nothing to connect.
Will the AI sound like a robot to my customers?

It answers in a natural voice and holds a real conversation, asking a follow up question when it needs one instead of reading from a script. It answers under a name you choose, not a menu. Every call is recorded and summarised, so you can hear exactly how it sounded.
Do I have to change my number?
No. Bring the number your customers already know and we transfer it free, or take a new one in your local area code. Either way it is one line on one bill.
Do I forward my calls to it?

No forwarding. We are the carrier, so the answering is part of the line itself rather than a service sitting on top of someone else. There is nothing to set up with another provider and no second bill.
Is $99 per line or per business?
$99 per line, per month. There is one plan and no tiers, so a second line costs the same as the first.
What happens when the AI can't handle something?

It passes the call to you. When someone asks for something it should not answer on its own, it transfers the call, and you get the summary either way so you know what was already said before you ring back.

About three minutes on an eSIM, scanned in the app. A physical SIM ships free and arrives in two to three days. Keeping the handset on your counter takes five to seven days, and the adapter is included.
